overall_summary: Data volume is low with one outlier outlier video (wife emotional video at 1.6k views). Most family and relationship videos cluster around 100-300 views. Confidence is low, requiring a blend of the winning family/relationship dynamic and controlled exploration.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on close relationships (wife, parents, general relationships) outperformed purely abstract shayaris. The wife-focused short hit 1,666 views, while general relationship reality hit 378 views.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on relatable domestic and relationship realizations.

weak_patterns.evidence: Sister emotional videos severely underperformed (e.g., 18 views and 135 views), indicating audience fatigue or poor hook delivery for that specific sub-topic.
weak_patterns.action: Pause direct sister-focused shorts temporarily and pivot to broader partner or universal life relationship themes.
